headline: EU proposes data center sustainability labels
summary: The EU has proposed a sustainability labeling system for data centers, requiring disclosure of energy and water use, ahead of bringing in minimum efficiency standards.

claims.statement: The EU has proposed a sustainability labeling system for data centers.

sources.quote: The EU has proposed a sustainability labeling system

claims.statement: The EU is also considering minimum efficiency standards for data centers.

sources.quote: ahead of bringing in minimum data center performance standards
as Commission eyes minimum efficiency standards

claims.statement: Engadget reports the rules will force data centers to disclose their energy and water use.
